description: Create the 4 new page components and update AiGenerator. These are self-contained files that do not depend on each other. Create QuizManager.jsx, ContentManager.jsx, ArchivesAdmin.jsx, AdminDashboard.jsx, and modify AiGenerator.jsx. Also append new CSS classes to App.css.

Step 2 — Create c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\pages\QuizManager.jsx. Import { useState, useEffect } from 'react', DashboardLayout from '../components/DashboardLayout', { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext', { quizApi, exportApi } from '../services/api'. The component structure has three panels (null = list, 'detail', 'create', 'edit'). LIST: header with '+ Créer un quiz' button; filters row with 3 selects (matiere freetext via input, statut: all/brouillon/valide, niveau: all/debutant/intermediaire/avance); useEffect calls quizApi.getAll({ matiere, statut, niveau, page, limit: 10 }) on mount and when filters/page change; store result in { data: quizList, total }; pagination prev/next buttons; cards using workspace-cards className, each card shows titre/matiere badge/niveau badge/statut badge/dateGeneration, action buttons: Voir (setPanel detail), Modifier (setPanel edit + load quiz), Dupliquer (quizApi.creerVariante then refresh), Valider (quizApi.valider then refresh, hidden if statut==='valide'), Publier/Dépublier (quizApi.publier then refresh, shows 'Public' or 'Privé'), Supprimer (confirm window.confirm, then quizApi.remove then refresh). DETAIL panel: show quiz titre/matiere/niveau/statut at top; below show questions array from quizApi.getOne(id) call; each question in div.quiz-question-card showing enonce, 4 choices in div.quiz-question-choices (each choice labeled A/B/C/D, add className 'correct' if it matches reponseCorrecte), explication; per-question buttons Modifier (open question form prefilled) and Supprimer (quizApi.removeQuestion); 'Ajouter une question' button opens inline question form; export panel below with 4 buttons using exportApi.download(exportApi.quizPdfUrl(id, false)), exportApi.download(exportApi.quizWordUrl(id, false)), exportApi.download(exportApi.quizPdfUrl(id, true)), exportApi.download(exportApi.quizWordUrl(id, true)), styled with quiz-export-panel and quiz-export-btn classes. QUESTION FORM (inline): fields enonce (textarea), choixA/B/C/D (4 inputs), reponseCorrecte (4 radio buttons labeled A B C D), explication (textarea); submit calls quizApi.addQuestion or quizApi.updateQuestion then refreshes quiz detail. CREATE/EDIT form: fields titre (input required), theme (input required), matiere (input required), niveau (select debutant/intermediaire/avance), visibilite (select prive/public); submit calls quizApi.create or quizApi.update then refreshes list and closes panel. All async operations set loading=true and handle error in catch block showing workspace-error class.

Step 3 — Create c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\pages\ContentManager.jsx. Import same deps plus contentApi and exportApi. Component has two tabs ('mes-contenus' and 'public') stored in state, and a panel state (null/create/edit/view). TABS: div.tabs-row with two button.tab-btn (active class when selected). LIST: filters using workspace-filters grid (search text, type select: all/cours/resume/serie/examen/quiz, statut select: all/brouillon/valide); useEffect calls contentApi.getMesContenus or contentApi.getPublic depending on active tab, passing { type, matiere: search, page, limit: 10 }; actually search filter should filter client-side on titre/theme since API may not support text search — call API with type and page only, filter locally by search text; store { data, total } in state; pagination prev/next; workspace-cards grid, each card shows titre/type badge/statut badge/matiere/dateCreation, actions: Voir (setPanel view + fetch content detail), Modifier (setPanel edit, only for mes-contenus tab), Dupliquer (contentApi.dupliquer then refresh), Valider (contentApi.valider then refresh, hidden if statut==='valide'), Publier/Dépublier (contentApi.publier then refresh), Supprimer (confirm + contentApi.remove + refresh), PDF button (exportApi.download(exportApi.contentPdfUrl(id))), Word button (exportApi.download(exportApi.contentWordUrl(id))). VIEW panel: show titre as h2, contenu in a pre/div.workspace-preview-body. CREATE/EDIT form: fields titre (input), type (select cours/resume/serie/examen/quiz), matiere (input), theme (input), contenu (textarea 14 rows); submit contentApi.create or contentApi.update.

Step 4 — Create c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\pages\ArchivesAdmin.jsx. Import { useState, useEffect } from 'react', { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom', DashboardLayout, useAuth, { archiveApi } from '../services/api'. STATE: archives list, total, page=1, filter matiere/promotion strings, uploadOpen boolean, uploadForm { file: null, matiere: '', promotion: '' }, textPanel { archiveId: null, text: '' }, loading, error, notice. On mount and filter/page change: archiveApi.getAll({ matiere, promotion, page, limit: 10 }) → store data. FILTERS: div.workspace-filters with 3 items: matiere text input, promotion text input, reset button. UPLOAD FORM (shown when uploadOpen=true): file input (accept='.pdf,.doc,.docx'), matiere text input, promotion text input, submit button calls archiveApi.upload(file, matiere, promotion), on success setNotice and refresh list and setUploadOpen(false); handle error. CARDS: workspace-cards, each card shows nom/type badge/matiere/promotion/taille (show in KB: Math.round(taille/1024)+'KB')/dateDepot; actions: 'Voir le texte extrait' button → archiveApi.getTexte(id) → store text in textPanel state and show div.archive-text-panel below that card; 'Générer depuis cette archive' button → navigate('/ai?archiveId='+id); Supprimer → confirm + archiveApi.remove + refresh. Pagination prev/next.

Step 5 — Create c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\pages\AdminDashboard.jsx. Import { useState, useEffect } from 'react', { Navigate } from 'react-router-dom', DashboardLayout, useAuth, { adminApi, matiereApi, promotionApi } from '../services/api'. GUARD at top of component body: const { user } = useAuth(); if (user?.role !== 'administrateur') return <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace />. STATS: useEffect calls adminApi.getDashboard(), stores result in dashStats; show in div.workspace-stats grid (render Object.entries(dashStats) as stat cards showing key/value if dashStats is plain object, or specific fields if known). USERS SECTION: div.admin-section with h2 'Utilisateurs'; useEffect calls adminApi.getUsers(), stores in users array; table.admin-table with columns: Nom, Prénom, Email, Rôle, Actions; per row: td with nom, td prenom, td email, td role, td with buttons — Supprimer (confirm + adminApi.deleteUser + refresh users), 'Assigner matières' button that toggles an inline div.admin-assign-form with input (comma-separated matières) and save button calling adminApi.assignerMatieres(id, inputValue.split(',').map(s=>s.trim())), 'Assigner promotions' same pattern. MATIÈRES SECTION: div.admin-section with h2 'Matières'; useEffect calls matiereApi.getAll(); show as table with columns: ID, Nom, Description, Actions (Supprimer button); inline create form with nom input + description input + Créer button → matiereApi.create; per row edit button toggles inline edit form → matiereApi.update. PROMOTIONS SECTION: same pattern with promotionApi.

Step 6 — Update c:\Users\ASUS\Desktop\projet-ExoCraft\frontend-projet\frontend\src\pages\AiGenerator.jsx. Add import { useSearchParams } from 'react-router-dom' at the top. Inside AiGeneratorForm component, add const [searchParams] = useSearchParams(); and const archiveId = searchParams.get('archiveId'); at the top of the function. Add conditional info banner: {archiveId &&
📎 Génération depuis l'archive #{archiveId} — le contenu sera basé sur ce document.
}. In handleGenerate function, replace the aiApi.generate(payload) call with: const data = archiveId ? await aiApi.generateFromArchive(archiveId, payload) : await aiApi.generate(payload); No other changes.
